founder.quote: Showing up as you are is the most courageous thing you can do — and you don't have to do it alone.
founder.bio: A trauma-informed, queer-affirmative psychotherapist working with individuals, groups, and organizations to make mental health feel a little less lonely. Integrative, person-centered, and committed to meeting you where you are.
